settings.heading: the story
settings.headline: Every character has a story.
settings.story:
GiGi was created as a way to personify friends, their moods, quirks and adventures.

Over time she became a character of her own, travelling through imagined worlds and collecting stories along the way.

These prints are small fragments of that world.

settings.heading: Made with care. Meant to be kept.
